description: Canonical 100-case LCB library on polyethylene (C2) backbone. It reuses the LCB100 branch-count, branch-arm length, topology, and branch-position design matrix, but replaces the isotactic propylene backbone with an achiral polyethylene backbone. Case names use generic polymer-family labels for automated comparison with PP-LCB releases.
